info.name: POS Gateway API
info.description:
Signed gateway `POST /api/v1/gateway` (docs/gateway-api.md).

1. Import this collection and `pos-local.postman_environment.json`, select the environment.
2. Admin → Administration → API Clients → New API client; copy the appid and secret into the environment.
3. Run `1. Customers → Register customer` first.

Request bodies only hold `method` and `biz_content`: the collection's pre-request script adds timestamp, nonce_str, version, sign_type, appid and sign. The test script checks the response signature and saves ids for the next requests. Signature trouble: compare the `last_string_to_sign` collection variable with the server's.

exec: // dot-flatten, drop sign/sign_type and empty values, sort keys, k=v&..., &key=<secret>, SHA-256, uppercase.
if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return out;
Object.keys(value).forEach(k => gwFlatten(value[k], prefix === '' ? k : prefix + '.' + k, out));
return out; // an empty object/array adds nothing, like PHP
// Trimmed: a space or line break copied with the key is the most common cause of INVALID_SIGNATURE.
throw new Error('Set "appid" and "secret" in the selected environment (Admin → Administration → API Clients).');
throw new Error('"secret" must be the 64-character key shown once after creating or rotating the API client (got ' + secret.length + ' characters). Rotate it and paste the new one.');
// The body only needs "method" and "biz_content"; {{variables}} and {{$dynamic}} values are resolved here.
// Error-case requests set "_case" to break one thing on purpose; it is never sent.
const nonce = () => { const c = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'; let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) s += c[Math.floor(Math.random() * c.length)]; return s; };
// reuse_nonce takes the nonce of the last request the server got as far as recording (see the test script).
req.biz_content = Object.assign({ appid: testCase === 'bad_appid' ? 'pos-unknown-appid' : appid }, req.biz_content || {});
// Remember what later requests replay, and the string-to-sign for debugging (never the key).
pm.request.body.update({ mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ Request: req }, null, 2), options: { raw: { language: 'json' } } });
// dot-flatten, drop sign/sign_type and empty values, sort keys, k=v&..., &key=<secret>, SHA-256, uppercase.
if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return out;
Object.keys(value).forEach(k => gwFlatten(value[k], prefix === '' ? k : prefix + '.' + k, out));
return out; // an empty object/array adds nothing, like PHP
try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { /* not JSON */ }
pm.test('Answer is a {"Response": …} envelope', () => pm.expect(json && json.Response).to.be.an('object'));
// The server records a nonce only once the signature and timestamp passed.
pm.test('Response signature is valid', () => pm.expect(gwSign(res, String(pm.variables.get('secret') || '').trim())).to.eql(res.sign));
// The server sends what it signed while APP_DEBUG is on: same string → wrong key; different → content changed.
console.warn('INVALID_SIGNATURE: the signed content matches the server, so the "secret" in your environment is not this appid\'s key. Rotate the key on the API Clients screen and paste it again.');
console.warn('INVALID_SIGNATURE: the signed content differs.\n  Postman: ' + ours + '\n  Server:  ' + res.debug.string_to_sign);
// Pick up ids so the next requests in the folder just work.
? 'Pending: this card needs the emailed 6-digit code. Put it in giftcard_code and run "Verify emailed code".'
: 'Issued at once (no verification on this card). Gift card code: ' + biz.code + '. No need to run "Verify emailed code".');
console.log('branch_id = ' + m.branches[0].id + ' (' + m.name + ' ' + m.branches[0].name + '). Put that branch\'s 6-digit code in branch_code.');

item.name: 1. Customers
item.description: Register (create or update) and read a customer. Run Register first: the other folders use {{external_id}}.

request.description: Creates the customer at Silver, or updates name / email / phone. `created` tells which.
Profile, points balance, tier and progress to the next tier.

item.name: 2. Points
item.description: Award and read points. `reference` makes an award idempotent.

request.description: A new reference every time. `spent_amount` (optional) also counts towards the tier. The reference is saved as {{last_reference}}.

item.name: Award again with the same reference (replay)

request.description: Same reference and points as the last award: answers with the first award, `replayed: true`, no extra points.

item.name: Award to an existing customer without name

request.description: Without `name` the customer must already exist; their profile is kept.
Balance, next expiry, points by expiry, last 12 months, one page of history.
Current tier, guarantee, this cycle's spending, what the next tier needs.
Enrolled, upgraded, requalified, protected, demoted; newest first.

item.name: 4. Gift cards
item.description: List → exchange → (verify if the card needs the emailed code) → my gift cards. Create a gift card in Admin → Gift Cards first, and give the customer enough points.

request.description: Sets {{gift_card_id}} to the first card this customer can take.
`issued` (with the code) or `pending` (code emailed: with MAIL_MAILER=log it is in storage/logs). Sets {{exchange_id}}. Fails with NOT_ENOUGH_POINTS, OUT_OF_STOCK, TIER, LIMIT_REACHED, ...

Only for cards with two-step verification ("requires verification" on the gift card). The exchange must have answered `pending`; this request is skipped otherwise. {{giftcard_code}} is the 6-digit code emailed to the customer (with MAIL_MAILER=log: in storage/logs). Not the branch code and not the GC-… gift card code.

exec: // Skipped unless the last exchange is waiting for the emailed code.
console.log('Skipped: the last exchange is not pending (the card has no two-step verification, so it was issued at once).');
throw new Error('Put the 6-digit code from the email in the giftcard_code variable (see storage/logs/laravel-<today>.log while MAIL_MAILER=log).');

item.name: 5. Use gift card at a shop
item.description: A customer with an issued gift card goes to a merchant branch; the cashier types the branch's 6-digit code on the customer's phone and the card becomes `used`. Run "4. Gift cards → Exchange gift card" first (sets {{exchange_id}}), then List merchants (sets {{branch_id}}), then put that branch's code in {{branch_code}} (Admin → Merchants → the merchant → its branch; needs view-merchantcode).

request.description: Active merchants with their active branches. Sets {{branch_id}} to the first branch. Never branch codes.

item.name: Use gift card at the branch

request.description: Completes the gift card: status `used`, with used_at, used_at_merchant, used_at_branch. A card with a merchant works only at that merchant's branches (WRONG_SHOP). Errors: WRONG_CODE, TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS (5 wrong codes → 15 min lock-out), ALREADY_USED, EXPIRED, NOT_ISSUED (pending/cancelled), BRANCH_UNAVAILABLE, EXCHANGE_NOT_FOUND.

exec: throw new Error('Put the branch\'s 6-digit code in the branch_code variable (Admin → Merchants → the merchant → branch code).');

request.description: Same gift card, same branch: answers the same used card with `replayed: true` (an app retry after a timeout is safe). At another branch it is ALREADY_USED.

item.name: 6. Error cases
item.description: Each request breaks one thing on purpose and checks the error code.

request.description: Sends the nonce of the last request that got past the signature check again. Run any successful request first (within 5 minutes).
